Question: How do small additions of hafnium (0.5 at.%) and molybdenum (1.0 at.) to the base high-entropy alloy Al 10 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 affect microstructural characteristics and high-temperature mechanical properties, and can directional solidification further optimize these properties?. System: Al 10 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 (base), Al 9 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 Mo 1 (Mo-added), Al 9.5 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 Hf 0.5 (Hf-added). Question: How can high-throughput computational screening be used to discover lightweight, precipitation-strengthened high-entropy alloys with high-temperature strength superior to traditional ferritic superalloys?. System: Al–Cr–Fe–Mn–Ti quinary system (specifically Al20Cr5Fe50Mn20Ti5 and Al15Cr5Fe50Mn25Ti5 as successful cases). Processing: Arc-melting of 99.9 wt% purity constituent elements, melted at least six times for homogeneity, followed by drop-casting; subsequent homogenization at 1200 °C and annealing at 700 °C for 2 hours for specific characterizations. Test conditions: Compression tests at room temperature and elevated temperatures (up to 700 °C) at a strain rate of 2 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹; in situ neutron scattering from room temperature to 1050 °C; synchrotron XRD and TEM characterization. Question: Can refractory high-entropy alloy WTaMoNbV be adequately synthesized via a laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) process using mixed elemental alloying powder as the raw material, and how do its properties compare to a counterpart produced by arc melting furnace (AMF)?. System: Refractory High-Entropy Alloy WTaMoNbV (20 at.% W, 20 at.% Ta, 20 at.% Mo, 20 at.% Nb, 20 at.% V). Processing: Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) using EOSINT M290 system (400 W Nd-YAG laser, pure argon atmosphere); mixed elemental powders (20–70 µm) stirred for 6 h at 23 rpm; advanced trials parameters: 244 W laser power, 300 mm/s scanning speed, 0.10 mm hatch spacing, 0.03 mm layer thickness, 162.7 J/mm³ energy density, 67° layer rotation.. Test conditions: Density and Vickers hardness (HV10) measured; compression strength tested at 0.5 mm/min crosshead speed; electrochemical behavior assessed via potentiodynamic polarization in 3.5% NaCl solution at ambient temperature (scanning rate 0.5 mV/s)..
